page.overview:
Who is Drikall Bessarah?

Drikall Bessarah was a Devaronian male who served as the field medic of Wraith Squadron, a Galactic Alliance commando unit. he was assigned to Sharr Latt's unit during the investigation into Galactic Alliance Army General Stavin Thaal's involvement in the Lecersen Conspiracy. When Latt's and Bhindi Drayson's units crossed paths on the planet Vandor-3, the two units merged. During siege of Mount Lyss Meteorological Station, fellow Wraith Huhunna brought the wounded Drayson to Bessarah, who was the only field medic available at that time, after she had been shot by a Pop-Dogs trooper, a member of the elite Galactic Alliancce Army unit founded and led by Thaal. Despite his efforts, Bessarah was unable to save Drayson from her blaster rifle wound, and she died.

In addition to serving as Wraith Squadron's field medic, Bessarah also concocted various drugs that aided the squad's mission against Thaal, including a chemical capable of temporarily blinding members of the Pop-Dogs.
